# Avient Teams with Albert Invent® to Bring Chemistry AI to Its Global R&D Network


##### November 9, 2026


##


*Avient Teams with Albert Invent® to Bring Chemistry AI to Its Global R&D Network.*
*To download a high-resolution image, please click here:*[FOR MEDIA USE ONLY](https://avient.stockpress.co/s/31a1f4c2)


**Key Highlight**


- Collaboration connects scientific knowledge across Avient’s R&D sites to help customers get to differentiated materials faster


**CLEVELAND & OAKLAND, Calif. – November 9, 2026** – Avient Corporation (NYSE: AVNT), an innovator of materials solutions, and chemistry AI company Albert Invent® Corporation, today announced a collaboration that brings AI-powered tools and modern digital infrastructure to Avient’s global research and development (R&D) organization. The initiative is part of Avient’s Lab of the Future program and one way the company is putting Amplify Innovation, a key driver of the company’s strategy, into practice.


Through the collaboration, Avient is deploying Albert’s chemistry-native AI operating system for R&D to help scientists access and apply the company’s scientific knowledge, engage more naturally with complex information and accelerate the path from research to product development. The first phase is now live across key R&D sites in the U.S. and Europe, with expansion to additional sites underway. The platform brings electronic lab notebooks, data management, advanced analytics, and AI capabilities into one environment, replacing disconnected tools and paper-based processes with a single source of truth for experimental data.


Avient scientists can use Albert as an AI-powered thought partner throughout the research process, helping teams synthesize information, build on prior work and translate scientific findings into actionable insights. Rather than replacing scientific expertise, the technology aims to amplify it, allowing researchers to spend less time on manual data work, and more time developing differentiated materials for customers.


"Amplifying innovation means putting the full breadth of our technologies and expertise to work for every customer," said Phil Clark, Ph.D., Senior Vice President and Chief Technology Officer at Avient. "With Albert in our labs, our scientists can build on what we’ve learned across our portfolio and combine technologies in new ways instead of starting from scratch. That's where our digital evolution becomes a real advantage for customers: faster development, more robust results, and materials solutions that help them succeed."


"As a formulation chemist, I’ve seen Albert change the way I approach day-to-day R&D,” said Aparna Agrawal, Ph.D., Senior R&D Chemist/Engineer at Avient. “I can quickly search decades of experimental knowledge in plain language, find relevant past experiments, and apply those insights to new formulation challenges. That helps me make more informed decisions and focus on the experiments that matter most."


Together, Avient and Albert are focused on:


- Making experimental data and scientific knowledge easier to search, understand and reuse;
- Giving scientists chemistry-native AI to interact with their data through natural language, automate complex research workflows, and predict formulation performance; and
- Breaking down knowledge silos across sites and regions to deliver differentiated materials and technologies to customers.


“The most meaningful application of AI in materials science is not reducing the role of scientists. It is making scientists even better at what they do,” said Nick Talken, CEO of Albert. “Avient shares our belief that AI should put more capability into the hands of researchers, helping them build on the company’s scientific knowledge, pursue more ambitious questions and deliver better solutions for customers. We’re excited to work alongside the Avient team as they build the next generation of materials R&D.”
